summary.text: Rick Townsend is a Republican state representative from Brunswick who has represented Georgia House District 179 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An educator, he previously worked as a school principal, superintendent and CEO of a college and career academy.

paragraphs.text: His career experience includes working as the CEO of a college and career academy, a superintendent and a principal.
He has been affiliated with the Georgia Leadership Institute for School Improvement and the Georgia School Superintendents Association Human Resources Institute.

Townsend won the 2022 Republican primary for House District 179, defeating John Killgallon, and then the June 21, 2022 runoff, defeating Bob Duncan; he won the general election that November and was re-elected in 2024.
For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Economic Development and Tourism, Education, Judiciary Juvenile, and Natural Resources and Environment committees.
